# Representative untrusted-input checks for release security review.

! pe expand config-traversal.yaml
stderr 'config file reference escapes config directory'

! pe exp attest manifest --root root ../secret.txt
stderr 'path escapes manifest root'

! pe exp cache verify ../aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
stderr 'invalid sha256 key'

pe run-text shell-looking.prompt --var payload='$(touch marker)'
stdout 'Payload: \$\(touch marker\)'
! exists marker

-- config-traversal.yaml --
prompts: ../secret.txt
providers: [mock]
tests: []

-- secret.txt --
secret

-- root/ok.txt --
ok

-- shell-looking.prompt --
---
kind: pe.text.v1
inputs:
  payload:
    type: string
---
Payload: {{ .payload }}
